title: Purportedly AI-Generated 'King Trump' Fighter Jet Video Allegedly Posted by President Depicts Defecation Attack on 'No Kings' Protesters

behaviors.text: President Donald Trump reportedly posted an AI-generated video on Truth Social showing himself crowned and piloting a fighter jet labeled King Trump, dropping feces on protesters, including influencer a person, during No Kings demonstrations.
The clip, allegedly created by another account, drew criticism from Sisson and musician a person, whose song "Danger Zone" was reportedly used without consent.
